scripts.desktop:dev: concurrently -k -n next,electron -c blue,green "npm run dev" "wait-on http://localhost:3000 && ELECTRON_START_URL=http://localhost:3000 electron electron/main.cjs"
scripts.desktop:dir: npm run build && npm run desktop:prepare && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.cjs --dir --publish never
scripts.desktop:dist: npm run build && npm run desktop:prepare && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.cjs --mac --publish never
scripts.desktop:dist:mac: npm run build && npm run desktop:prepare && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.cjs --mac --publish never
scripts.desktop:dist:unsigned: npm run build && npm run desktop:prepare && ELECTRON_BUILDER_ALLOW_UNSIGNED_MAC=1 electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.cjs --mac --publish never
scripts.desktop:dist:win: npm run build && npm run desktop:prepare && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.cjs --win --x64 --publish never && node scripts/prepare-windows-codemagic-artifacts.mjs
